MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  OCTOBER 15, 2024

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 7:05 p.m. at City of Rolling Hills Estates Council
  Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Dr. N., Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR
  MCCORMICK.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR MCCORMICK led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Pope, Ciarolla (joined at 7:14pm), Johnson,
  Holdsworth, Bain, Persichina, and McCormick

  Commissioners Absent:  None

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF AUGUST
  20, 2024

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR
  PERSICHINA to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  AUGUST 20, 2024.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MCCORMICK so ordered.

  B.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF
  SEPTEMBER 17, 2024

  COMMISSIONER POPE made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR
  PERSICHINA to:

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
October 15, 2024
   APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  SEPTEMBER 17, 2024.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MCCORMICK so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  NONE.

  6.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  **ITEM 6A DELAYED TO LATER IN THE MEETING **

  B.  CITY CELEBRATION DEBRIEF

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief overview of the City Celebration Debrief report
  (as per the agenda material).

  COMMISSIONER BAIN commended Staff on a great report and event. She also
  asked if it would be possible to state the vendor names either in the debrief report
  or in Attachment A. Supervisor Pinuelas stated that Staff can begin providing
  vendor information in future debrief reports beginning with next year’s event.

  COMMISSIONER POPE commended Staff on their volleyball match victory over
  the Lomita Sheriff Station.

  COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH stated that there was some confusion
  regarding the overflow parking area initially but otherwise parking appeared to be
  handled well by City staff.

  **ADJOURNED TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING AT
  7:12 PM**

  7.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  TRACY AUSTIN DOUBLES TENNIS TOURNAMENT UPDATE (VERBAL
  REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief update about the 2024 Tracy Austin Doubles
  Tennis Tournament. He briefly went over the current registration numbers,
  information regarding the Sponsors’/VIP Reception, current sponsorships and
  overall tournament preparations.

  Supervisor Pinuelas stated Staff are looking at increasing the attendance at the
  Sponsors’/VIP Reception and asked the COMMISSION to let Staff know if any

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
October 15, 2024
   Commissioners would like to attend. She also noted that Staff invited the Jack
  Kramer Club board members to attend the reception this year.

  COMISSIONER CIAROLLA JOINED THE MEETING AT 7:14 PM

  Supervisor Pinuelas noted that attendance numbers are currently tracking with the
  attendance numbers from previous years’ receptions, in response to
  COMMISSIONER POPE.

  COMMISSIONER POPE noted that anyone attending the reception are welcome
  to bring a guest including children to the reception.

  **RECONVENED PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING AT 7:15 PM**

  B.  FOUNDERS PARK UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief update that Phase 2 of the Founders Park project
  is in progress and Staff will update the COMMISSION as any updates arise.

  Supervisor Pinuelas noted that the play equipment had arrived, in response to
  COMMISSIONER BAIN.

  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that she will check if any information has been relayed
  to the public regarding Phase 2 of the project, in response to CHAIR
  MCCORMICK.

  C.  HOLIDAY PARADE OF LIGHTS UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief update regarding this year’s annual Holiday
  Parade of Lights. He stated that Staff is again working with Soundskilz who is
  providing parade management services for this year’s event. He noted that the
  pre-parade reception will once again be held at El Polla Inka. He also gave a brief
  overview of the current organizations that had registered for the parade and
  provided a sponsorship update.

  D.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.
  8.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  COMMISIONER JOHNSON stated that Dapplegray Park looked great. She asked
  about the lending libraries and if each park had one. Superintendent Goldsmith

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
October 15, 2024
   responded that most of the parks do and that they were created by local Scouts
  as Scout projects.

  Superintendent Goldsmith stated that the public typically keep the library boxes
  stocked, and Supervisor Pinuelas noted that Staff currently does not do any book
  drives to assist in stocking the stations, in response to CHAIR MCCORMICK.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  In response to COMMISSIONER BAIN, Supervisor Pinuelas stated that Staff has
  been approached by two separate pet adoption agencies regarding holding pet
  adoption events in the City. She noted that Staff are working with them regarding
  when and where the events could take place and would come back to the
  COMMISSION to discuss any events prior to finalizing, in response to
  COMMISSIONER BAIN.

  9.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF AUGUST 13, 2024

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF AUGUST 20, 2024 SPECIAL MEETING

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  10.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  A.  ASSESSMENT OF SPACE FOR POTENTIAL DOG PARK AND FUTURE PARKS

  NONE.

  **ITEM 6A TAKEN OUT OF ORDER **

  6.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM FUNDING REQUEST
  FROM DAPPLEGRAY LANES PROPERTY OWNERS ASSOCIATION

  Superintendent Goldsmith gave a brief overview of the proposed street entryway
  beautification program funding request from the Dapplegray Lanes Property
  Owners Association (as per the agenda material).

  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that there are partial funds available for this project but
  not the full $2,500 amount so a budget adjustment request to City Council is
  needed for the remaining $800 and at that time Staff will request an additional

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  4
October 15, 2024
   $2,500 for a fourth project that has been in the works, in response to
  COMMISSIONER POPE.

  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that the fourth project would still come to the
  COMMISSION prior to approval of that project but the funds would be included in
  the budget adjustment request, in response to VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA.

  Superintendent Goldsmith responded that there were three proposals submitted
  for the Dapplegray project, in response to VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA.

  Superintendent Goldsmith stated that the Bennett Landscape and Finley’s Tree
  and Landscape were two separate proposals. Supervisor Pinuelas clarified that
  the Dapplegray Lanes Property Owners Association (DLPOA) received three
  proposals and will be picking one of them. She also clarified that they have
  selected the Finley’s Tree and Landscape proposal, in response to
  COMMISSIONER BAIN.

  Supervisor Pinuelas noted that the Bennett Landscape proposal was two pages,
  and each page had a separate subtotal and that the total amount of the proposal
  was on the second page, in response to COMMISSIONER CIAROLLA.

  Superintendent Goldsmith responded that it appears that the DLPOA has not been
  satisfied with Bennett Landscape’s care on the current entryway as a possible
  reason for why the more expensive Finley’s proposal was accepted. He also noted
  that regardless of how much the Association is willing to pay for the project, the
  City would only give $2,500 in matching funds for an entryway project, in response
  to COMMISSIONER CIAROLLA.

  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that based on the current Street Entryway
  Beautification Program Guidelines that the City’s financial participation would not
  exceed fifty percent of the approved project’s actual costs, with the City’s matching
  amount not to exceed $2,500, in response to VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA.

  COMMISSIONER POPE made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  HOLDSWORTH TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL
  CALL VOTE:

  THE DAPPLEGRAY LANES PROPERTY OWNERS ASSOCIATION’S
  REQUEST OF $2,500 IN MATCHING FUNDS FROM THE CITY’S STREET
  ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM IN FY 2024-25 PENDING A
  BUDGET ADJUSTMENT REQUEST TO CITY COUNCIL TO ALLOCATE
  ADDITIONAL FUNDS FOR THE COMPLETION OF THIS PROJECT.

  AYES:  Pope, Ciarolla, Holdsworth, Bain,
  ABSTAINS: Johnson, Persichina, McCormick
  ABSENT:  None

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  5
October 15, 2024
   11.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR MCCORMICK ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 7:34 PM TO THE NEXT
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON NOVEMBER 19, 2024, AT
  7:00 P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD AT CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CITY
  HALL.

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,
